name: Yumi Wulandari
source:
Staff Sergeant / Comms. Operator
Nationality: Indonesian/Japanese

Kind and shy. Her hardworking nature earned her the position of Executive Officer, making her Cornelia's second-in-command. She idolizes Cornelia and always strives to be just like her.
